Bill.BriefDescription: Providing sales and use tax exemptions to encourage the use of alternative fuels.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemptions to encourage theuse of alternative fuels; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to the sale of,and labor and services rendered in respect to, tangible personalproperty installed on a motor vehicle if the property enables thevehicle to operate using an alternative fuel. Only parts and othercomponents that are specific to enabling a motor vehicle to operateusing an alternative fuel are exempt under this section. (2) The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) For the purposes of this section, "alternative fuel" means a p. 1 SB 6516fuel that is at least fifty percent, by volume, alcohol fuel, biodieselfuel, biodiesel feedstock, or wood biomass fuel, as these terms aredefined in RCW 82.29A.135.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to theuse of tangible personal property, labor, or services if the property,labor, or services enable the vehicle to operate using an alternativefuel. Only parts and other components that are specific to enabling amotor vehicle to operate using an alternative fuel are exempt underthis section. (2) For the purposes of this section, "alternative fuel" means afuel that is at least fifty percent, by volume, alcohol fuel, biodieselfuel, biodiesel feedstock, or wood biomass fuel, as these terms aredefined in RCW 82.29A.135.
